setup.title: First-run setup
setup.lead: About a minute. You can change all of this later in Settings.
setup.invalid: Please enter your name and pick a country.
setup.name: Your name as companies know you
setup.nameHelp: Used in the letters we draft for you. Companies use it to find your records.
setup.aiRules: Rules only, no AI — nothing is sent to DeepSeek.
setup.aiGate: DeepSeek can be turned on only after you confirm its training opt-out in

consent.do1: Read sender, subject and date of your emails (not the message body).
consent.do2: Send the requests you approve, from your address.
consent.do3: Watch for replies to those requests only (we open the body of those replies, nothing else).
consent.store: Company names, email counts and dates, up to 3 subject lines per company, and the requests you send.
consent.never: Read email bodies to scan, sell your data, or send anything you didn't approve.

ai.title: How we use AI
ai.body: When AI assist is on, the app sends these to DeepSeek using your API key: sender display names, sender domains, up to 3 redacted subject lines per company and header flags (for grouping and tagging), and public privacy-policy text (to find contact addresses). Letters are written from templates on this server; your name, email, message bodies, your other contacts and OAuth tokens are never sent. DeepSeek's own terms decide how they store API data. Switch to “Rules only” to send nothing.

whatWeSee.title: What we can see
whatWeSee.lead: This is your own private app. Here is exactly what it reads, keeps and never touches.

read.title: What we read
read.body: For scanning: the sender, subject, date and list headers of your emails. Never message bodies. The only bodies we open are replies to requests you sent, so we can show them to you.

store.title: What we store
store.body: Company names, email counts and dates, up to 3 subject lines per company (deleted 90 days after the scan), your decisions and the requests you send. Mailbox access tokens are encrypted.

never.title: What we never do
never.body: Read email bodies to scan, sell or share your data, or send anything you didn't approve.

ai.title: AI
ai.body: AI assist is off by default (Rules only). If you turn on DeepSeek in Settings, only sender names, domains, up to 3 redacted subjects per company, header flags and public privacy-policy text are sent.

control.title: You stay in control
control.body: Nothing is pre-selected and nothing is sent without your explicit approval. You can disconnect a mailbox or remove the app's access in your Google or Microsoft account at any time.
